title.en: QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions

summary.ja: 15本の特殊化求積と15本のSimpson対照を固定入力で比較します。
summary.en: Fifteen specialized quadratures and fifteen Simpson companions use fixed inputs.

assumptions.ja: 無限Gaussian、有限振動2周波数、半無限Fourier、内部特異点。絶対公差1e-6/1e-8/1e-10、epsrel=0。
assumptions.en: Whole-line Gaussian, two finite frequencies, half-line Fourier and an internal singularity; absolute tolerances1e-6/1e-8/1e-10 and epsrel0.

algorithm.ja: 領域と重みを明示しfull_outputの活動prefixを保持。既存Simpson関数は不変。
algorithm.en: Explicit domain/weight dispatch retains active full_output prefixes. The existing Simpson function is unchanged.

validation.ja: 独立の解析区間参照と実callback数を照合します。有限Gaussianは点値でなく厳密区間です。
validation.en: Independent analytic interval references and actual callback counts are checked. The finite Gaussian target is an interval, not an invented erf value.

limits.ja: Simpsonの特異節点失敗と未達精度を保存し、推定誤差の一般保証にしません。
limits.en: Singular-node failures and unmet Simpson goals remain visible; error estimates are not general guarantees.

summary.ja: 9本の適応GKと24本の固定DE和を比較します。
summary.en: Nine adaptive GK rows and twenty-four fixed DE sums are compared.

assumptions.en: Integrate exp(x), x^(-1/3) and -log(x) on[0,1], with h from1/2 to1/16 and cutoffs3/4.

algorithm.ja: 共有15節点、G7次数13/K15次数23。DEは安定log式と全端点重みです。
algorithm.en: Shared15-node G7 degree13/K15 degree23; DE uses stable logarithmic products and full endpoint weights.

validation.ja: 解析区間参照で全誤差、連続tail、有限窓誤差を分離します。
validation.en: Analytic interval references separate total error, continuous tail and finite-window defect.

limits.ja: 半無限exp-sinh/全実線sinh-sinhは未実装。無限台形SUMの省略項のboundは提供しません。
limits.en: Half-line exp-sinh and whole-line sinh-sinh are unimplemented; no omitted infinite-grid sum bound is provided.

title.en: Tensor and Smolyak controls in two to four dimensions

summary.ja: 滑らかな積と相互作用積の42本の固定cubatureを比較します。
summary.en: Forty-two fixed cubatures compare a smooth product and an interaction product.

assumptions.en: The integration domain is[0,1]^d for d2/3/4; tensor levels1/2/3 and sparse levels1/2/3/4.

algorithm.ja: 正規化dyadic角キーで同一節点を所有し、符号付き重みと評価台帳を保持。
algorithm.en: Canonical dyadic angle keys own shared nodes; signed weights and call ledgers are retained.

validation.ja: 解析積分と独立Delta/combination組立を区別し、L<dの相互作用未解像を可視化。
validation.en: Analytic integrals are distinct from companion Delta/combination assembly; interaction underresolution at L<d remains visible.

limits.ja: 一般の誤差単調性、常時正重み、疎格子の費用優位は主張しません。物理PDEの空間ではありません。
limits.en: No general error monotonicity, positive-weight or cost-superiority claim; these are integration coordinates, not a physical PDE space.
